title: Pet-Theft Dispatch Needs a Verified Police or Court Record
excerpt: No arrest, seizure, verdict, date, location, or named agency appears here. Honest reporting must stop before it invents stolen pets, weapons, or raids.
body_html:
No police seizure, court verdict, intercepted shipment, or named victim appears in the available material. That leaves no documented incident to describe without inventing heartbreak, weapons, cages, transport conditions, or criminal roles.

Evidence must come before outrage

Pet theft demands precise records: date, location, investigating agency, procedural status, seized animals, and court or police source. Without those facts, claims about syndicates, poison baits, stun guns, forged quarantine papers, or stolen family companions remain unverified.

Biosecurity still demands action

Rabies creates a separate public-health duty. Transmission generally requires infected saliva to enter through a bite, scratch, broken skin, or mucous membrane. After possible exposure, wash the wound with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes and seek urgent medical assessment. Post-exposure prophylaxis includes vaccination and, when indicated, rabies immunoglobulin or approved monoclonal antibodies. Once clinical symptoms appear, rabies is virtually 100% fatal. Properly cooked meat is not an established rabies transmission route. See World Health Organization guidance.

Demand records. Demand reform.

Vietnamese families and animal-protection leaders can demand transparent enforcement, veterinary controls, and protection from companion-animal theft. SDE’s campaign calls for nationwide abolition by 2030. Sign the national petition and add your name to that public demand.
